# Ny turbulens i USA og styr på skatten

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish episode of Millionærklubben (EuroInvestor), dated 17 Nov 2026. US tech and AI-chip stocks sold off (Nasdaq 100 −2.7%) with Nvidia's earnings due, while in Denmark Novo Nordisk rose on CagriSema data and FLSmidth fell about 9% after its CFO left abruptly. Most of the episode covers Danish investor tax planning. At the end, Lars Svendsen gives bullish views on product tanker Torm, with possible takeover upside, and on BW LPG ahead of its 24 November report.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 TRMD-A — Torm | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Svendsen bought back Torm personally. Possible takeover bid with the holder above 25% (30% is the threshold). Target 280-300 after dividend, about 20% upside in roughly 3 months.

#### Reasoning

Host-analyst Lars Svendsen re-bought Torm for his own account. He expects a possible takeover as the major holder nears the 30% mandatory-bid threshold. He sees structural support from product shortages and longer routes to Asia, and targets 280-300 ex-dividend, framing it as about 20% in three months.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the takeover bid does not materialise
- if the oil market disruption ends and product tanker rates normalise
- if the price reaches the 280-300 target

> *"jeg har sat sig på 280-300 også efter de der udbytte er hoppet af"*

---

### 🟢 BWLPG — BW LPG | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Price 214 with the report due on the 24th, which Svendsen expects to be 'helt formidabelt'. He sees a move to 300 but is unsure about the timing.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen expects a very strong Q3 report next week and a share price target of 300 from 214, about 40% upside. He admits the main uncertainty is how long it will take to get there.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the 24 Nov report disappoints
- if LPG freight rates weaken

> *"Der kommer regnskab den 24. Her om en uge. Og det skulle gerne være helt formidabelt. Og i den regner jeg jo med, at vi skal i 300."*

---

### ⛔ FLS — FLSmidth | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Svendsen does not own it and calls it too expensive at about 512. His price target is 400. He questions the shrunken business, cement-divestment provisions and the abrupt CFO exit.

#### Reasoning

Svendsen sees FLSmidth as overvalued. It disposed of its cement business for little and with large provisions, has halved in size, and analysts are flattered by margin optics from the remaining 'best boys in class'. The CFO's sudden exit over strategic disagreements adds management risk after a recent CEO change.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the price falls toward 400
- if the new strategy delivers clear organic growth

> *"Jeg mener, at den er for dyr"*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Svendsen is more optimistic after the CagriSema data, less pessimistic than consensus, and says Novo is regaining its reputation, but he expects continued share loss. Investor day today.

#### Reasoning

The CagriSema lower-dose data showing 21% weight loss improved Svendsen's view. He notes Novo is naturally losing share from a near-monopoly start but is regaining standing, and the CEO speaking at the investor day is a near-term catalyst. He gave no explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if market share erosion accelerates
- if CagriSema data or regulatory progress disappoints

> *"Ja, det gør det, og jeg er ikke så pessimistisk, som de fleste er"*

---
